description: Translate reviewed project objectives and contact policies into a proposal with explicit entry, exit and measurement rules.

guide.applicability: Use when the project owns audience semantics, channel policy, cadence and guardrail definitions.
guide.context_boundary: Strategy documents cannot authorize audience mutation, message delivery or scheduling in an external system.
steps: Resolve objective, eligibility, exclusions, contact policy, cadence, exit criteria and guardrail metrics.
Model the journey as a value-free proposal with measurement and conflict checks.
Require a separate governed connector preview, explicit user authorization and readback for every mutation.
guide.title: Governed operations journey proposal

summary: Describe a staged contact journey without creating audiences, messages or schedules.
